updates.checkFailed: Couldn't reach the update server. Check your connection and try again.
updates.checksHint: Once a day, read the latest release from GitHub and show it in the status bar.
updates.autoHint: Download new versions in the background and install them when Gostman closes or restarts.
updates.autoHintInstaller: Download new versions in the background, then install them when you restart Gostman and Windows asks for permission.
updates.availableDetail: Gostman downloads it, makes sure it arrived intact and installs it when you restart.
updates.availableUnverified: This version can't be installed automatically, so download it from the releases page.
updates.updateHint: Download version {{version}}, check it and install it
updates.verifying: Making sure the download is complete…
updates.readyHint: Version {{version}} is downloaded and checked. Restart Gostman to install it.
updates.restartMessage: Gostman closes and opens again at version {{version}}. Open tabs and unsaved drafts are kept.
updates.restartMessageInstaller: Gostman closes, Windows asks for permission to install version {{version}}, and Gostman opens again. Open tabs and unsaved drafts are kept.
updates.downloadHint: Open the release notes and downloads on GitHub
updates.failedHint: See what went wrong in Preferences, Updates

failures.network: Couldn't reach the update server. Check your connection and try again.
failures.unsupported: There's no automatic update for this system yet, so download it from the releases page.
failures.unverified: Gostman couldn't confirm this update is genuine, so it wasn't installed. Download it from the releases page.
failures.mismatch: The download didn't come through correctly, so it wasn't installed. Try again.
failures.storage: Gostman couldn't save the download on this computer. Free up some space and try again.
failures.install: Gostman couldn't install the update. Close it and run the installer from the releases page.

manual.scoop: Installed with Scoop. Update it with {{command}}.
manual.homebrew: Installed with Homebrew. Update it with {{command}}.
manual.system: Installed as a system package, so download the new package from the releases page and install it.
manual.other: This copy of Gostman can't update itself, so download new versions from the releases page.
